scope.same_timestamp_policy: shared group; no invented within-group order
scope.revision_policy: state must be active at a strictly earlier timestamp; conflicting user-item-timestamp groups are counted but not applied
scope.staging_contract: lossless NumPy memory maps from /root/autodl-tmp/0809 Yambda/phase0_5b_audit/work/flat_explicit_5b/manifest.json; no row filtering or value transformation
